name: Black Domina
summary: **Black Domina** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] launched in 1996 by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]], a four-way cross combining [[northern-lights|Northern Lights]], Ortega Indica, [[hash-plant|Hash Plant]], and an Afghani line called SA.

sources.title: Black Domina: With the power of the four indica hearts
sources.note: Ortega Indica and the Afghani line 'SA' are not separately cataloged, so only Northern Lights and Hash Plant appear in parents.
